name: China Industrial Securities International Financial Group Limited
summary: China Industrial Securities International Financial Group Limited provides various financial services in Hong Kong. It operates through Wealth Management, Corporate Finance, Asset Management, Financial Products and Investments, and Others segments. The company engages in the provision of securities, futures, options, and insurance brokerage services; margin financing services; fund management, discretionary account management, and investment advisory services; and investment holding platforms and management of general working capital services.
